summary.text: Kyle Hilbert is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 29, which contains parts of Creek and Tulsa counties. He was elected the 45th Speaker of the Oklahoma House of Representatives in January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Hilbert attended Oklahoma State University, where he earned a bachelor’s degree in agribusiness and a master’s in business administration and served as Student Government Association president.
Before becoming Speaker, Hilbert served three sessions as Speaker Pro Tempore and spent three years as vice chair of the Appropriations and Budget Committee.
His House biography says he authored the DRIVE Act on transportation funding, helped create the Redbud School Funding Act, and championed the Strong Readers Act.
Hilbert and his wife have three young daughters and live in Bristow.
